title: European buildings
hook: EUBUCCO is a “database of individual building footprints for 200+ million buildings across the 27 European Union countries and Switzerland, together with three main attributes – building type, height and construction year – included for respectively 45%, 74%, 24% of the buildings.” The researchers, who describe their methodology in a recent paper, collected and standardized the information from 50 open government datasets and OpenStreetMap.
